description: Maya owns the family's only working camcorder and is organizing an evening for Nina and Omar to record oral-history interviews with older relatives. Maya must make the final call about the recording format, sharing rules, backup plan, and practical arrangements.

shared_context.S1: The family wants to preserve several older relatives' stories in recordings that can be listened to by future family members.
shared_context.S2: Maya has the only working camcorder, and she is coordinating the recording evening and deciding how the files will be handled afterward.
shared_context.S3: The recordings will include both video and spoken audio, and the family has a shared digital drive for family materials.
shared_context.S4: Maya's normal planning habit is to ask Nina and Omar in turn for their preferences and practical advice before confirming a family recording plan.

PF1.text: Nina's grandmother told her that she is willing to be recorded only if the interviews stay in the family archive and are not posted publicly online; Nina has not yet relayed this request to Maya or Omar.

PF2.text: Omar's friend Priya, who works as an audiovisual archivist, advised him that the audio should be captured as uncompressed WAV at exactly 48 kHz and 24-bit depth, with two verified backup copies; Omar has not yet shared this advice with the group.

acceptance_conditions: The recordings must be designated for the family archive only.
The recordings must not be posted publicly online.
Audio must be captured as uncompressed WAV at exactly 48 kHz and 24-bit depth.
The files must have two verified backup copies.
A commitment to carry out the archival audio capture must be recorded.
A commitment to keep the recordings within the family archive must be recorded.
Nina's privacy request must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: Nina's grandmother's specific request changes the release setting to family_archive_only, changes online_posting to False, and requires a family_archive_restriction commitment.
Priya's archival advice changes audio_format to uncompressed_WAV_48kHz_24bit, changes backup_plan to two_verified_copies, and requires an archival_audio_capture commitment.
